reviews.text:
Better than Jordan Hongdae. You can also see the staff who worked in Hongdae. It's the same boss. i envy you.
Please let me win a lot of shoes. Why not just once? ㅠㅠ
It consists of a total of four floors in a single building.
The floor you enter from the entrance is the first floor. You can get custom shoes and custom t-shirts here. For custom tees, you can choose one of five designer works and include up to two of them. Lettering is not yet possible, and only the designer's drawings can be included. There are three sizes, large and small, and the price varies depending on the size of the picture.
Custom shoes must be decorated by yourself at the table after purchasing Jordan 1 Mid White shoes. You can decorate it using paint-like pens and tape. For someone who is bad at art, it doesn't seem easy to take on the challenge. If there is a style you want, it seems better to ask an art major or someone with talent.
If you go up to the second floor, women's clothes and shoes are the main items. The Cows figures and Bearbricks in the middle of the DP are impressive. The staff responded very kindly (seeing as the store manager was a person who worked at Hongdae Jordan, so it seems like they trained in the same system) and the fitting room was very well decorated. When I looked at various YouTube videos, I heard that the fitting room also had works by famous artists, and it was great. Considering that the third floor is for employees only, I expect there to be an office, warehouse, and break room. The 4th floor is a rooftop and has a basketball goal. Actually, I think I can do three to three. If you come down again, there is a basement, here expressed as the 0th floor. There are kids' clothes, shoes, family shoes, and various accessories. Jordan Kids product types are definitely smaller in quantity compared to Play Kids Pro. It seems to be aimed at adults, not kids. Still, the kids' products are a bit disappointing since the students who grew up watching Jordan are now parents. I think it may have been because kids’ sales at Hongdae Jordan were minimal. There are Jordan figures and Bearbricks everywhere here too. Famous designers' works are hung everywhere, and even in the staircase, there are beautiful paintings on the walls. It is a wonderful place where a lot of effort and sincerity was put into it.
I love jordan. We are in jordan.

reviews.author: Justin Ma
reviews.text:
I purchased about 600,000 won worth of clothes at this store. It included pants, shirt, sweater, and coat. Overall, the salesperson was friendly and the store atmosphere seemed nice. However, there were two major problems with the clothes I purchased. The first is the durability of the clothes, and the second is the tax-free refund system.

Let's talk about durability first. The pants were the first issue. After wearing it once, the waist button fell off. It's not a serious issue, but I'm concerned about the durability of other clothes as well. After washing and wearing the sweater a few times, it began to pill and lose its shape.

For the tax-free refund system, the store provides sales tax refunds to visitors through the Global Tax Free (GTF) company. They say you can get a refund by presenting the receipt you received from the store at the airport. However, when I presented the receipt at the airport, the refund was not processed because an error occurred at the automatic refund kiosk. I checked directly at the airport, but the staff said there was nothing more they could do and told me to contact Global Tax Free (GTF) directly. I contacted GTF, but they did not give me a refund because they did not have a physical receipt. I'm not sure if it's a problem with this store or with GTF, but other duty-free store refund systems I've used haven't been handled properly.

reviews.author: in your heart
reviews.text: Eclavaci is a stylish jewelry store located on the luxury street in Cheongdam-dong, a collection of jewelry shops visited by people who want to find something of their own style, away from the bustling market-like Jongno jewelry stores. Eklavachi refers to people who emit radiance. Befitting its name and reputation, it is good to have a high-quality service mindset that accurately understands what customers want and explains it calmly, in detail, and leisurely. The after-sales service warranty period is generous, and if the size does not fit, there is also a service that will re-make the product for a small fee. This is possible because we operate our own workshop within the store. In particular, among the Eclavaci collections that attract people's attention with creative designs even if they are made of the same precious metal, Venustas is especially famous for its simple yet unique design. This is a must-visit place for couples looking for luxurious and unique jewelry or for those considering a gift for the bride and groom about to get married.

reviews.text: On this day, I stopped by 7 Aladdin used bookstores (Bucheon, Goyang, and Nowon course) and was running out of time, so I arrived at Sinsa Station with about 5 minutes left in a hurry, using crutches. I was rude and showed the purchase list and coordinates that I had written down in advance, and asked for help in finding the store. The manager readily accepted, cleaned up the back of the store on his own, and took a picture of the notes written by the staff. I was able to purchase about a dozen books in about 10 minutes. I saw some books placed in places that were slightly different from the coordinates, but compared to the Bundang Seohyeon branch, they were on a charming level. I was deeply moved by the kindness of the staff and was able to go back and see Garosu-gil for the first time in my life.
